_about: GUARDRAIL-DEMO latency (not for normal use). Caps the fault-window latency p95 of telemetry_stall at 30 ms, below the normal poll latency on the test Mac (44-72 ms in run 20261011T000246Z-46ea3d), so the guard should trip on the first sample. Tighten-only: the implicit defaults are a 2 s poll timeout and a threshold never below 250 ms. Deliberately tight: this proves the abort-and-rollback path, not a real slowdown. max_duration_s lowered 30 -> 15 so duration + poll timeout stays within the 30 s hard cap.

telemetry_stall.description: GUARDRAIL-DEMO latency: telemetry_stall with a deliberately tight 30 ms latency cap.
expected_symptoms: GUARDRAIL-DEMO: the first fault-window poll slower than 30 ms trips guardrail_latency and the run rolls back
